allot.subject: Monitoring Agency Report
allot.text: The Belrise Industries Limited has submitted to the exchange monitoring agency report of IPO and QIP for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

allot.subject: Dividend
allot.text: Belrise Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Recommendation of final dividend of Rs. 0.55 (@ 11%) per equity share for the financial year ended March 31, 2026 on the equity shares issued and allotted under QIP, subject to the approval by members of the Company at the ensuing Annual General Meeting.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Belrise Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange:1. The Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results ( Financial Results ) for the quarter ended June 30, 2026; 2. Limited Review Report issued by statutory auditor on the Financial Results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026; 3. An unmodified opinion on the Financial Results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026; 4. Recommendation of final dividend of Rs. 0.55 (@ 11%) per equity share for the financial year ending March 31, 2026 on the equity shares issued and allotted under QIP, subject to the approval by members of the Company

allot.subject: Committee Meeting Updates
allot.text: Belrise Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Committee Meeting held on July 17, 2026. regarding allotment of equity shares under QIP.
